name: calculator
description: Evaluate math expressions (arithmetic, trig, logs, factorials, etc.), or compute a percentage, percentage change, or compound interest.

action.description: evaluate: any math expression. percentage: what % part is of whole. percentage_change: % change from original to new. compound_interest: compound interest calculation.

expression.description: A clean mathematical expression only, e.g. '25*4' or 'sqrt(144) + 3'. Required for action='evaluate'. Never include any non-math words here.

rate.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage (e.g. 5 for 5%). Required for action='compound_interest'.

time.description: Time in years. Required for action='compound_interest'.

compounds_per_year.description: Compounding frequency per year. Defaults to 12 (monthly) for action='compound_interest'.
